decision: Retain the junction-based detector as the current schematic building block, disconnected from pad enables. Normal-reference DC trip spread improves, but reproducible low-voltage output, shutdown latency and retained output charge still require a reset-dominant local clamp/discharge and controlled restart. DC trip values do not qualify pad safety.
scope: Transistor/resistor DC corner screen with a 500 fF declared load. Logic-high threshold is 0.7 times supply, not proof that lower voltages cannot partially enable a pad. No hysteresis, reference generation, transient reset/brownout, mismatch, extraction or connected-pad safety qualification.

transient.scope: Typical FET/BJT and resistor models,27C,500fF output load. Duration is sampled integration, not a rigorous timing bound. Supply/reference/reset are prescribed external transitions; output is generated by the physical circuit. High output during invalid supply and retained output after power loss remain failures to resolve. No pad gate fanout, layout, ESD or device-survival qualification.

rejected_mos_control: The prior MOS-threshold floor asserted below2.5V in ff/fs with degraded reference and required about3.0V in ss at1V reference; not selected. Reproduce with floor_kind=mos,floor_ratio=3.2.

connected_receive_diagnostic.scope: Same extracted RX/USB pad, retained 3.3V peers and 500fF additional control load. Schematic supervisor and ideal control wires; no layout/fanout or latch/blanking sequencer. FS_HIGH_P and PULLUP_N are simultaneous generic branch exercises, not a legal USB transaction. Separate pad supply probe retains displacement/backfeed current even when supervisor consumes supply current. Bias/reference and supply waveforms remain explicit fixture inputs.

extended_brownout_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic 10k supervisor only; same retained pad branches and peers. Early supply backfeed decays, but settled pads remain near 1.55V instead of the unloaded external divider level of 3V. The remaining current path is unidentified. Not steady-state leakage or safety qualification.

stronger_discharge_diagnostic.scope: Typical FET/BJT and resistor models,27C,500fF output load. Duration is sampled integration, not a rigorous timing bound. Supply/reference/reset are prescribed external transitions; output is generated by the physical circuit. High output during invalid supply and retained output after power loss remain failures to resolve. No pad gate fanout, layout, ESD or device-survival qualification.

integration_decision: Do not adopt 10k supervisor: active current exceeds monitor allocation. Late brownout tracing identifies about 1.0603mA from PAD_P through four steering diodes into ESD_RAIL, while functional branch terminal currents are at nanoamp scale. Prioritize protection-rail holding/release behavior under ordinary externally powered peers before more supervisor tuning. No corrected protection circuit or safety qualification yet.

brownout_branch_trace.scope: Zero-volt current probes at all non-capacitive PAD_P device terminals in the unchanged extracted subcircuit; all branches retained. Late brownout means, not ESD qualification or a corrected design.

protection_clamp_state.scope: Unmodified connected diagnostic; internal node voltages only. Window averages do not establish final equilibrium or ESD survival.
protection_clamp_state.interpretation: At late brownout the timing node is about 0.763V, close to the 0.753V isolated rail, yet the shunt gate remains about 0.757V. This is consistent with low-voltage inverter-chain release failure rather than an uncharged timing capacitor alone. It does not establish infinite-duration holding or a safe remedy. Active and recovered windows are also loaded.

protection_long_hold.scope: Connected diagnostic with all extracted devices retained; optional100k gate discharge uses eight schematic PDK resistors without added layout routing. Window averages do not establish final equilibrium or ESD survival.

protection_gate_discharge_candidate.scope: Connected diagnostic with all extracted devices retained; optional100k gate discharge uses eight schematic PDK resistors without added layout routing. Window averages do not establish final equilibrium or ESD survival.

protection_release_decision: Do not promote gate discharge alone. It restores normal signal voltage but the same100mA/2ns diagnostic peaks at8.099V on PAD_P and7.109V on ESD_RAIL before shunt turn-on. Unchanged baseline peaks4.013V but starts incorrectly conducting. Starting states differ by design; this does not isolate resistor-induced delay. Need fast protection from the correctly released state plus reliable release, followed by process/layout/stress verification. Compact-model extrema are not device survival evidence.

False.scope: 100mA positive2ns diagnostic into PAD_P after1us startup/brownout, all pad attachments and board peers retained. Typical models27C, schematic gate-discharge option. Not a standardized ESD waveform, current-density/thermal qualification, core survival or settled-DC acceptance; transient operating-point initialization is permitted for this lifecycle comparison.

True.scope: 100mA positive2ns diagnostic into PAD_P after1us startup/brownout, all pad attachments and board peers retained. Typical models27C, schematic gate-discharge option. Not a standardized ESD waveform, current-density/thermal qualification, core survival or settled-DC acceptance; transient operating-point initialization is permitted for this lifecycle comparison.

protection_direct_trigger.scope: 100mA positive2ns diagnostic into PAD_P after1us startup/brownout, all pad attachments and board peers retained. Typical models27C, schematic gate-discharge option and optional three100um diode-connected6V NMOS trigger devices with grounded bodies; no added layout routing. Not a standardized ESD waveform, current-density/thermal qualification, core survival or settled-DC acceptance; transient operating-point initialization is permitted for this lifecycle comparison.
protection_direct_trigger.decision: Not selected. Three diode-connected100um6V NMOS devices preserve about2.999V pre-pulse signal but reduce peak only8.099 to7.842V; isolated rail still6.814V. This does not close released-state protection. Avoid blind sizing sweeps; address trigger drive and primary-to-core coordination together.

pad_facing_terminal_exposure.scope: 990..1499ns includes pulse and recovery. Only measured waveform nodes or exact fixture voltage-source relations are used. Unknown internal voltages are not inferred from off controls or nominal supply. Device voltage class is not a transient survival limit. Full internal-node traces and terminal current/duration limits remain required.
